title: Superman
short: The Reeve films, Returns and the 2025 reboot
blurb: Four films with Christopher Reeve, a 2006 film that pretends two of them never happened, and a fresh start in 2025.

supermaniv87.t: Superman IV: The Quest for Peace

note: Superman Returns is a sequel to Superman II and ignores the third and fourth films. The 2025 film begins a new continuity. Henry Cavill's Superman is on the DC Extended Universe page.
